title: Euro exchange rates (ECB): free JSON API and PHP library
description: Free static JSON API and PHP library with the official euro foreign exchange reference rates published by the European Central Bank since 1999.
lead: The official reference rates of the European Central Bank since 1999: a free static JSON API, with no server and no keys, and a PHP library. It updates itself every business day; latest publication: {{LATEST_DATE}}.
use_api_text: JSON files on GitHub Pages: no server, no keys, open CORS.
use_lib_text: codecruz/currency-flow on Packagist: lookups, history, cross rates and conversions.
use_server_text: The same data on your own domain, with custom ranges and a health check.
api_intro: Every route is a static JSON file served by GitHub Pages, with open CORS. A route without data returns 404.
route_rates: Any day since {{FIRST_DATE}}. Weekends and holidays return the previous publication.
route_history_year: Series of a currency for one year
route_currencies: Every currency ever published, with its period and whether it is still active
note_base: Rates state how many units of the currency equal 1 EUR.
note_strings: Values are decimal strings exactly as the ECB publishes them, so no precision is lost.
note_dates: date is the publication used and requested_date the date asked for. If they differ, it was a weekend or holiday.
note_schedule: The ECB publishes around 16:00 Frankfurt time on every TARGET business day.
lib_intro: The same data for PHP 8.2+, with a PSR-16 cache, history, cross rates between any pair of currencies and conversions. Available on Packagist:
server_intro: If you need custom date ranges, your own domain or a health endpoint for your monitoring, the repository includes a ready-to-deploy HTTP API (Slim 4, RFC 7807 errors, ETags and an OpenAPI 3.1 specification):
footer_source: Source: European Central Bank. The reference rates are published for information purposes only.
suggest_text: This page is also available in English.
js_no_rate: No rate was published for that date.
js_fallback: There was no publication on {requested}; the one from {date} is used.
nf_text: There is no data at this route. Dates use the YYYY-MM-DD format, cannot be in the future and start on 1999-01-04. Currencies use their ISO 4217 code in capitals (USD).
